statement: A no-rise guard compared the prospective rubric with the calibrated one on the same input, so on a depth-1 clone it accepted any result no higher than the calibrated score, and that score was itself read from one commit where the window holds twelve: the full clone scored B2 verified 3.6, the depth-1 clone warning 3.2. A guard anchored to a baseline on a degraded input inherits the baseline's defect and passes it. Rules: when a guard compares two scorers on a degraded input (shallow, partial, truncated), also compare the baseline's degraded result with its own result on the complete input; and before narrowing any guard, state which of the two comparisons each change moves.
